review.why: Executes an implementation plan inline, task by task, with test-first steps, a decision ledger and one fresh review of the whole branch at the end.
review.summary: For when the user chose inline execution or no subagent tool exists. It follows the plan exactly, proves each step with a test seen failing then passing, records every deviation as a ruling in a ledger, and does not pause between tasks. Only four things stop it: irreversible actions, security-sensitive actions, side effects outside the worktree, and a plan so broken every path is a guess.
strengths: Ledger of rulings makes decisions recoverable after a context loss
Clear short list of when it must stop and ask
Honest about what inline execution gives up versus per-task review
cautions: Depends on a plan written by its companion skill
Long plans give the last tasks the least attention, as it admits
Bundled scripts and the rest of the process are not read here
